dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 17, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Red Sox Dominate Rays in Doubleheader, Dodgers Edge Yankees in Thrilling Finish**

The Boston Red Sox swept a doubleheader against the Tampa Bay Rays, winning 10-0 and 5-3 behind dominant performances from their hitters and pitchers. Carlos Narváez led the charge, hitting a three-run homer in the first game and finishing with three hits and three RBIs. In the second game, Wilyer Abreu hit two home runs and drove in three runs for the Red Sox.

In other action, the Los Angeles Dodgers edged the New York Yankees 2-1 on a solo homer from Max Muncy in the bottom of the 8th inning. Gerrit Cole struck out eight for the Yankees, but was outdueled by Jack Dreyer, who earned the win for the Dodgers.

The Atlanta Braves routed the Texas Rangers 15-1, with Drake Baldwin hitting a five-RBI homer and Chris Sale pitching seven shutout innings for the Braves. The Chicago White Sox rolled to a 12-4 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Sam Antonacci hitting a two-run homer and Tyler Schweitzer earning the win with three scoreless innings.

In other results, the Milwaukee Brewers edged the Miami Marlins 2-1, with Joey Ortiz hitting a solo homer for the Brewers. The Minnesota Twins beat the Chicago Cubs 5-2 behind a strong performance from Bailey Ober, who struck out seven in 5.1 innings. The Baltimore Orioles edged the Houston Astros 3-2, with Taylor Ward hitting a two-RBI homer for the Orioles. The Kansas City Royals outlasted the San Diego Padres 7-6 in a back-and-forth contest. The Cincinnati Reds cruised to a 7-2 win over the Colorado Rockies behind a strong outing from Brady Singer. The Detroit Tigers edged the Los Angeles Angels 2-1, with Troy Melton striking out nine in 5.2 innings. The Washington Nationals routed the Athletics 23-4 behind a dominant performance from Cade Cavalli, who struck out nine in six innings. The St. Louis Cardinals edged the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-4 in a thrilling finish. The San Francisco Giants blanked the Seattle Mariners 7-0 behind a strong performance from Bryce Miller. The Pittsburgh Pirates rolled to a 7-1 win over the Cleveland Guardians behind a strong outing from Jared Jones, who struck out nine in five innings.
